basis: V11 actual rollout: qualified early repair plus no reborrow reduces focal wrong loss, but some opportunities are blocked by outstanding strong commitments and old channels exceed combined count cap.
selection: Both prespecified variants across all nine markets. COUNT_STRICT is V11 JOINT with all Active channels sharing the original combined count authority. PREPARE adds cancellable strong-commitment removal, and only trades against the canonical state after release.
acceptance_note: The old 95% profit-retention rule is not the user's new objective. This study permits a substantial tradeoff but separately requires an actual 2:1 gain/loss relation, material downside reduction and meaningful activity. Ratios are explicit experimental definitions, not a statement that the user supplied a numerical threshold.
execution: Native actual fill engine with original queues, latency, full15 passive and dynamic active. No terminal winner in actor. Qualified repair creates its own payoff responsibility, not a fake increase to old finite-work remaining quantity.
paired_scoring: Separate fixed-correct/wrong actor runs from the two possible settlement branches of a single run. Report both.
audit: Confirm exact OFF controls, pre-intervention identity, canonical receipt reconciliation and all failed original safety flags. Do not treat an algebraic quote opportunity as a fill.
resources: DESKTOP-JIERAGF only for heavy work, up to four single-thread native children. Main machine prepares scripts and reads compact summaries.
limits: Nine previously consumed historical markets, not fresh unseen evidence. Inherited zero-fee research, not current live net PnL. Existing tail rule remains unchanged.
deployment: No original V49 or 8781 changes. No real orders or collector changes.
preparation: Hypothetical removal only determines whether cancelling risk could make a repair affordable; no hypothetical state is fed to execution or payoff accounting. Cancellable flags must be true for actual CANCEL requests. Pending cancel/UNKNOWN liabilities remain charged until actual canonical release.
known_limit: A short-lived quote may disappear while waiting for cancellation; this is a real failure mode, not justification for fake fill or fake budget release. Earlier activation can reduce favorable returns and requires paired tests.
